text: BAM share rose 0.07 percentage points over 23 hours and 0.28 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 34.5%. Node concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 21.7% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Top-node leadership changed hands 70 times in the window, a whale-driven routing pattern rather than evidence of an additional structural rollover.
